correctness.rationale: Deleting first + and final - bijects primitive length-2n excursions with Catalan(n-1) Dyck words. The finite uniquely parsed positive-excursion code has bounded return times 2..2N. Induced suspension entropy and Gibbs inequality give the unique pressure root for every N≥1 (N=1 has h=0). The critical weights a_n=C_{n-1}/4^n sum to 1/2 and satisfy a_n~(4sqrt(pi))^{-1}n^{-3/2}. Writing t=2N(log2-h_N), the bulk n≤N/2 contributes o(1), while the endpoint Laplace contribution tends to e^c/(2sqrt(pi)) for t=.5logN+loglogN+c. Monotone bracketing at c=.5log pi proves the o(1) law. Independently solved finite renewal roots at N=100,1000,10000 with residual <5e-15, found t=4.601166876,6.162955772,7.615242740; finite slow convergence is not an infinite proof.
